When a man has sharp corners, it is hard for him to roll along through the world, and he loses by it. A round thing can go rolling anywhere without trouble, but a square thing not only takes effort to roll; each time it rolls, its corners are rubbed away, and that hurts. After all, this world is not ours alone, and people will not all become what one wants them to be. To put it plainly, you lose by setting yourself against men who have money.
